subject.title: fix: resolve Tavily SecretRefs in agent tools

question: Should this broader branch be the canonical landing path for both the Tavily fallback bug and the agent Tool Search runtime-snapshot bug?
rationale: The narrower open PR fixes only Tavily, while this branch adds a distinct shared agent-runtime repair; choosing the permanent ownership and landing scope requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Land broader branch
options.body: Use this PR as the canonical guarded fix after refreshed exact-head gates, then retire or retarget the narrower Tavily-only candidate.

options.title: Split agent repair
options.body: Land the narrower Tavily-only PR and require this branch’s shared agent Tool Search runtime-snapshot changes in a separate focused PR.

options.title: Pause both branches
options.body: Keep both candidates open only if maintainers want a different canonical SecretRef/runtime-config design before landing either implementation.

recommendation.title: Land broader branch
recommendation.body: Use this PR as the canonical guarded fix after refreshed exact-head gates, then retire or retarget the narrower Tavily-only candidate.
